crossRefs.note: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…

people.name: Jared
people.line: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch

people.name: Mahalalel
people.line: Descendant of Seth; ancestor of Noah

translations.web: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
translations.asv: And Mahalalel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
